title: Tools
description: Each tool puts your models to work on one task.

cards.study: Turn any topic into a short course, with lessons and quizzes.
cards.proofread: Correct or rephrase a text and see every change.
cards.transcription: Turn a video from the web or an audio file into text, then into a document to read.
cards.workshop: Hand a long task to your models: they plan it, write it part by part and check every part.
